summary: Align accepted OpenSpec outcomes, unit-aware SemVer, distributable versions, dependency pins, and consumer-facing changelog prose without publishing.

outcomes: Derive unit release impact and consumer-facing notes from schema-classified OpenSpec release artifacts.
Verify release manifests, dependency pins, and native version sources across single, independent, or composed topologies.

scenarios.title: Prepare a product release
scenarios.prompt: Use the maintain-release-story skill to prepare the next release unit from completed OpenSpec changes without publishing it.
scenarios.outcome: A verified release set aligns effective SemVer, manifests, dependency pins, components, and consumer-facing changelog entries.

scenarios.title: Audit release consistency
scenarios.prompt: Use the maintain-release-story skill to check whether unit versions, dependency pins, and release notes match the accepted product changes.
scenarios.outcome: Version, dependency, ownership, or release-story drift is reported with its authoritative source and exact repair boundary.
